answer: Every piece of work carries a content hash in the Juniper registry, which refuses any second claim with a matching hash. A wandering auditor re-checks one claim in twenty within a day, and a summit of three reviewers settles disputes in two days. A duplicate forfeits a 500-coin bond and bars the identity a month, so a thousand fakes would lose 500,000 coins. One farm filed one report under forty names; the registry flagged all forty in an hour.
